shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'next.config.*' -g 'app/**' -g 'src/app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'src/pages/**' -g 'middleware.*' -g 'instrumentation.*' | head -200 && git status --short --branch && git branch --show-current"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- package.json && cat package.json && cat next.config.ts && sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,240p' app/news/page.tsx && sed -n '1,240p' app/preview/page.tsx && sed -n '1,240p' app/layout.tsx && rg -n \"cacheComponents|use cache|revalidate|unstable_noStore|noStore|cookies\\(|headers\\(|draftMode|connection\\(\" . --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' --glob '"'!package-lock.json'"'"
/bin/bash -lc "git branch --list && ls -la | sed -n '1,100p' && (test -d node_modules && node -p \"require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version\" || true) && cat tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short --branch && git diff --stat && git diff -- next.config.ts app/news/page.tsx app/preview/page.tsx tsconfig.json package.json && git ls-files --error-unmatch package-lock.json >/dev/null 2>&1; printf 'package_lock_tracked=%s\\n' \""'$?"'

/bin/bash -lc "python3 -c 'import pathlib, shutil; shutil.rmtree(pathlib.Path(\".next\")); pathlib.Path(\"next-env.d.ts\").unlink()' && git status --short --branch && git diff --stat && git diff -- app/news/page.tsx app/preview/page.tsx next.config.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "git restore -- tsconfig.json && python3 -c 'import pathlib, shutil; shutil.rmtree(pathlib.Path(\".next\")); pathlib.Path(\"next-env.d.ts\").unlink()' && git diff --check && git status --short --branch && git diff --stat && git diff -- app/news/page.tsx app/preview/page.tsx next.config.ts"
